entities.summary: Leader of Grenada (1979–1983). New Jewel Movement; Marxist-Leninist; Cuban ally; charismatic; airport project; assassinated October 19, 1983 by own party hardliners (Bernard Coard faction); US invaded 6 days later; body never found
